name: Dephaser JPY
oneLiner: JPYT is DePhaser's yen stablecoin, minted by locking USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base against a yen FX oracle, with collateral returned on redemption.
collateral: USDT (Optimism) and USDC (Base) deposited by users to mint JPYT; locked collateral is automatically transferred into Aave for safekeeping rather than held directly by DePhaser, backing JPYT against the yen
pegMechanism: Users lock USDT (Optimism) or USDC (Base) to mint JPYT priced off real-time USD/JPY rates from Chainlink and Pyth oracles; the deposited collateral is routed into Aave, and redemption burns JPYT to return the underlying USDT or USDC

oracleRisk.summary: DePhaser mints JPYT using Chainlink USD/JPY exchange-rate data for USDT/USDC deposits, with no fallback or failure handling documented.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Freeze-only re-review: JPYT has no direct holder freeze or blacklist function in the reviewed source; burnFrom remains allowance-gated even when called by BURNER_ROLE. JPYT resolves to Upstream through locked USDT/USDC reserve exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: JPYT is a non-upgradeable OpenZeppelin AccessControlEnumerable ERC-20. On Optimism, MINTER_ROLE is held by a single contract (0x77c1e40f5e7bb19c34d81f986fb13fe655f23cd9, likely the DepositManager) and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE by an EOA. On Base, MINTER_ROLE is held by a distinct contract (0x0eab9d66adb8527cd7c0e7e7c1782580431ec276) and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE by a separate EOA. No supply cap is enforced on the token itself.

review.evidence: At Optimism block 152,830,546: non-upgradeable OZ AccessControlEnumerable token. MINTER_ROLE (1 holder): contract 0x77c1e40f5e7bb19c34d81f986fb13fe655f23cd9 (DepositManager). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (1 holder): EOA 0xbdeb54641a23e2716a2978cde3cdeb1aed335479. Base deployment has distinct contract minter (0x0eab9d66adb8527cd7c0e7e7c1782580431ec276) and EOA admin (0x2db58fcae002ae16963f122dd657bb360398c54c). No proxy or upgrade mechanism; authorityPosture downgraded from unbounded-or-compromised to concentrated-admin as mint is routed through a contract, not a raw EOA.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JPYT is tracked on OP Stack chains and the candidate evidence points to OP Mainnet canonical routing. No separate issuer bridge route was resolved, so the route is reviewed as canonical rollup bridge exposure.
